payload.reason: The evidence provides specific metrics for evaluating models in the communication game, focusing on efficiency and accuracy.

claims.text: Models are evaluated based on the retention rate of tokens, which measures the fraction of tokens kept in the keywords.
The accuracy of a communication scheme is measured by the fraction of sentences generated that exactly match the target sentence.
A good communication scheme should be efficient (using fewer keywords) and accurate (reconstructing the target sentence with high probability).
